**Description**
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human-in-the-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them.
  
  
We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year and an ambitious 2027 roadmap. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production
* Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, and human takeover of agent sessions
* Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team
* Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product
* Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces
* Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response

A day in the life
  
  
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross-team syncs or design reviews. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause - not just the symptom. We encourage responsible AI usage across our development workflow - it's one way our team moves fast. The problems are interesting and the pace is high but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it.

Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Billing to build the systems that make Braintrust’s pricing, usage, and payments accurate, scalable, and transparent.
  
  
Braintrust helps teams observe, evaluate, and improve production AI agents. Our customers generate large volumes of traces, run automated and human evaluations, use AI-powered product features, and retain data under different plans and policies. Billing needs to turn those product activities into clear, reliable customer experiences—from usage measurement and plan enforcement to invoices, credits, and account state.
  
  
You’ll work across the billing stack: usage metering, subscriptions and entitlements, payment integrations, invoicing, credits, and the internal systems that reconcile them. This is a deeply technical IC role. It is not a finance-operations role, and it is not a backend generalist role that contributes to billing occasionally.
  
  
You’ll be a technical authority on billing correctness and scale, helping Braintrust launch pricing models that let customers adopt the platform with confidence as their AI workloads grow.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Core responsibilities:
  
  

* Own Braintrust billing architecture end-to-end, including metering, plans, subscriptions, entitlements, invoices, credits and payments.
* Design our billing architecture to solve immediate needs and simplify billing for new features as they are developed and released.
* Ensure Braintrust accurately measures and bills for product usage, including processed data, evaluation scores, model usage, and data retention.
* Partner with product, infrastructure, finance, and customer-facing teams to introduce new pricing models and billing workflows with confidence.

Build the systems that power Braintrust billing, such as:
  
  

* A reliable usage-metering and aggregation pipeline that turns product activity into accurate customer usage.
* A subscription, limits, and entitlement system that supports plan allowances, feature access, trials, upgrades, and on-demand usage.
* Internal tools and APIs for investigating billing anomalies, issuing credits, and helping customers understand their account state.
* Observability across the billing pipeline, including metering lag, event completeness, reconciliation discrepancies, and payment health.

* Expert-level understanding of TypeScript, Rust, SQL, backend systems, APIs, and distributed data-processing patterns
* Experience building and operating production usage-based billing, payments, or subscription systems
* Experience with metering, aggregation, idempotency, reconciliation, and event-driven architectures
* Experience integrating with Stripe or similar payment infrastructure
* Experience building or maintaining financial ledgers, credits, balances, or invoice systems is a plus
* Comfortable shipping end-to-end, from backend infrastructure and data systems to internal tools and customer-facing UI
* Previous experience founding or working at startups is a plus
* Has an appreciation for the tension between moving quickly and preserving customer trust and billing correctness

**Job Description**
AI/ML Researcher — Advanced Manufacturing Systems
  
  
At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility through human-centered design—creating vehicles and experiences made to be seen and felt. From breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment, we’re turning what seems impossible today into tomorrow’s standard.
  
  
Our products move millions of people every day. We’re working to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected—and to shape the future of transportation around the world.
  
  
The role
  
  
The R&D Manufacturing Systems Research Group is seeking a researcher to develop and apply artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) solutions for advanced manufacturing systems.
  
  
You’ll tackle real-world manufacturing challenges in areas such as process improvement, quality, automation, production efficiency, and decision support. Working with multidisciplinary teams, you’ll develop concepts, build prototypes, evaluate results, and help transition promising solutions into manufacturing applications.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Conduct applied research and technical development at the intersection of AI/ML and manufacturing systems. Partner with researchers, manufacturing engineers, plant personnel, operations teams, and external collaborators to identify opportunities and develop practical solutions.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and evaluate AI/ML models for manufacturing engineering and production applications.
* Build data pipelines, prototypes, analytical tools, and decision-support solutions.
* Apply methods such as machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, large language models, computer vision, time-series modeling, and optimization.
* Work with manufacturing data from sensors, equipment, processes, simulations, and operational systems.
* Translate engineering and manufacturing challenges into research questions and technical plans.
* Design experiments, validate results, and assess technical and business impact.
* Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies for their potential value to GM manufacturing systems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, universities, suppliers, and technical experts.
* Communicate results through presentations, reports, publications, and invention disclosures.
* Stay current on AI/ML methods, tools, and responsible AI practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related field.
* Experience developing and evaluating AI/ML models through academic or industrial research, internships, or applied engineering projects.
* Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks or analytical tools.
* Knowledge of data preparation, model training, validation, performance evaluation, and experiment design.
* Experience working with structured or unstructured data, such as sensor, time-series, image, text, or process data.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and contribute effectively to a multidisciplinary research team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience applying AI/ML to manufacturing, engineering, robotics, automation, scientific computing, or industrial operations.
* Knowledge of manufacturing process modeling, process control, quality systems, production systems, optimization, or operations research.
* Experience with one or more of the following: computer vision, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, digital twins, simulation, reinforcement learning, generative AI, large language models, or agentic systems.
* Experience with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Keras, MATLAB, R, SQL, or cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
* Experience designing data architectures, integrating databases, or deploying models into operational environments.
* Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI.
* Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, patents, or invention disclosures.
* Experience collaborating with universities, suppliers, research institutions, or distributed technical teams.

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?



Your team
This job is with Statista R, a vertical business unit of Statista.

Statista R is a world leader in the creation of company, brand, and product rankings and top lists, based on comprehensive market research and data analysis: Statista R recognizes the best.

With a team of over 100 expert analysts and in cooperation with more than 40 high profile media brands across all continents like Forbes, TIME Magazine and Newsweek, Statista R creates transparency for consumers and business decision makers and helps companies build trust and recognition across a plethora of industries and product categories. A team of over 50 licensing specialists based in New York, Hamburg, Tokyo, and Singapore offers the awarded companies meaningful and eye-catching opportunities to communicate their success via logos and other award related products. Visit rankings.statista.com http://rankings.statista.com for further information about Statista R and our rankings.



Your Role

 - Design, build and maintain web applications for working with data as a core part of your role, mainly using Python frameworks such as Django and Streamlit

 - Work closely with our senior Data Engineer and other experienced data professionals who build our analytics products and pipelines, learn hands-on about our AWS cloud environment and ETL processes, and help build reliable data pipelines and PostgreSQL queries

 - Prepare, transform and validate data so our applications and analyses rest on a solid foundation

 - Create visualizations and insight reports that make findings clear and actionable, both to make our analyst team's processes more efficient and to produce strong client-facing materials

 - Work with teammates to turn analytical questions into usable features and workflows, and develop repeatable ways to build expertise and value for our stakeholders

 - Support projects based on large-scale, survey-based market research data, and help develop methods that complement our existing ranking products



Your Profile

 - Solid hands-on skills in Python, gained through professional work, internships, research, or your own projects. Experience coding in R is advantageous

 - Experience building web applications with Django and/or Streamlit is a strong plus. Knowledge of PostgreSQL or another SQL database, and basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is also a plus

 - A basic understanding of cloud environments such as AWS and of ETL concepts, and the motivation to grow these skills alongside experienced colleagues

 - Hands-on experience working with data, including querying, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and checking data quality

 - Clean coding habits that make teamwork easy, such as readable code and basic Git workflows

 - Enjoyment in building tools other people use, a collaborative way of working, and the curiosity to dig into unfamiliar problems
